pages.title: Chapter 6: Important Game Mechanics
pages.text: §8[Weight Tier System]$(br2)Forged metal products have three weight tiers that affect weight and attributes:$(br2)$(li)§8Light Tier§8 (Smaller): Weight ~75% of normal, lower damage$(br)$(li)§2Medium Tier§8 (Normal): Standard size, normal attributes$(br)$(li)§6Heavy Tier§8 (Larger): Weight ~125% of normal, higher damage$(br2)Weight tier is determined by the billet, randomly generated during crafting. Damage is based on weight: +0.1 damage per 100g, up to +2.0 max.

pages.title: §8[Cooling Mechanism]
pages.text: Softened billet cooling methods:$(br2)$(li)§6Water Cooling§r: Place softened billet in water to instantly cool it back to hard billet$(br)$(li)§6Inventory Cooling§r: Softened copper billet auto-cools after 1.5 minutes in inventory$(br2)Cooled billets lose their softened state and need re-heating for forging. Note: Only softened copper billets have a cooling mechanism.

pages.title: §8[Other Useful Features]
pages.text: $(li)§3Cooking Food§r: Fire pit can cook food and provide light$(br)$(li)§3Ash Fertilizer§r: Ash works as fertilizer to ripen plants$(br)$(li)§3Rock Building§r: 9 rock types can make stairs, slabs and walls$(br)$(li)§3Shift Tip§r: Hold Shift to view item details

pages.title: §8[Forging Safety Tips]
pages.text: $(li)§3Heat Protection§r: Use wooden clamp for hot items to avoid burns$(br)$(li)§3Material Match§r: Use the correct metal type's softened strip for carving$(br)$(li)§3Durability§r: Hammers and chisels wear out with use, keep spares

pages.title: §8[Advanced Tips]
pages.text: $(li)§3Batch Preparation§r: Heat multiple billets at once for efficiency$(br)$(li)§3Weight Selection§r: Re-craft billets until you get heavy tier$(br)$(li)§3Quick Find§r: Use /forgeodyssey find commands to locate resources$(br)$(li)§3Time Management§r: Watch for softened copper billet cooling time, forge promptly
